verdict.rationale: Natural-language analytics with a governed semantic layer is a fair question for a managed analytical database, since warehouses do ship such features. The evidence, however, shows only an MCP server that lets coding agents run raw SQL, plus column-level roles and query logging. These are developer building blocks and adjacent governance controls, not a business-user natural-language interface or semantic model that grounds answers. No evidence shows ObsessionDB itself delivers semantically-grounded natural-language answers.
